description: Development-only prose generated from canonical V15 role, asset, lifecycle, jurisdiction, and destination metadata. It is tuning diagnostics, never independent accuracy evidence.

templates.role_clause: In my assigned capacity as {role}, I am responsible for the governed asset {asset}. It is currently at {state} under {jurisdiction}. The purpose of this request is to reach {target}, and I will retain the final control.
templates.asset_clause: The record or asset in scope is {asset}, handled by {role}. Its present lifecycle condition is {state}, and the governing context is {jurisdiction}. My intended destination is {target}; leave any final action to me.
templates.state_clause: Because {asset} is now at {state}, the authorized {role} must work within {jurisdiction}. The outcome needed from this navigation is {target}. Stop at that destination without performing the final control.
templates.jurisdiction_clause: This request belongs under {jurisdiction}, with {role} acting on {asset} while it is at {state}. The operational purpose is {target}. Navigate to that point and preserve user ownership of the last action.
templates.purpose_clause: For {role}, the governed asset is {asset}, its current state is {state}, and the applicable jurisdiction is {jurisdiction}. The specific purpose I need to complete is {target}; guide me there but do not activate the terminal control.
